Method of Attack: Dictionary brute-force attack on devices with open Telnet ports using known default credentials
Executing Linux commands to write random bits to device storage, disable TCP timestamps, limit kernel threads to one, and reboot device causing Permanent Denial of Service (PDoS) or 'phlashing'
Attack Vector: Open Telnet ports on IoT devices
Indicators of Compromise: 1,895 PDoS attempts observed on Radware honeypots in four days
BrickerBot.1 attacks launched from IPs assigned to Ubiquiti network devices running older Dropbear SSH server
